reconstruction.canonicalization: Stable recursive JSON; all object keys lexicographically sorted; labels sorted by case_id; UTF-8; no insignificant whitespace.
reconstruction.safe_profile_derivation: For each fixture_ref, SHA256(secret_salt_hex + '|' + fixture_ref); inspect the last byte of the digest. If it is even, SAFE profile='p'; otherwise SAFE profile='q'. The other profile is MATERIAL_FALSE_SAFE.
reconstruction.truth_rule: truth='SAFE' iff profile equals the derived SAFE profile; otherwise truth='MATERIAL_FALSE_SAFE'.
